personality.description: This person tends to rely on familiar routines, proven methods, and conventional expectations, and may resist changes unless there is a clear practical reason. They are highly organized in daily life, paying close attention to details, keeping plans in order, and checking their work carefully before acting. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually look for a stable, rule-consistent answer and weigh consequences carefully, though they may defend their own judgment if they believe it is justified. In group discussions, they speak in a measured and organized way, listen reasonably well, and contribute steadily rather than dominating, but they will state their position firmly when necessary.
traits: has achieved positions of leadership through exceptional performance and abilities
focuses on fostering positive relationships and teamwork
cares a lot about what others think of them
takes input from others on how tasks should be accomplished
is quick to find common ground between other people's ideas and their own
